description: This file defines a service class UserCreatedShelfService for managing user-created book shelves, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and associated book retrieval within a book tracking application.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfService
classes.description: A Spring service for managing user-created bookshelves, including CRUD operations and retrieval of associated books.

methods.name: createCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates a new UserCreatedShelf object with the provided shelf name linked to the current user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a UserCreatedShelf by its ID.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Fetches all shelves belonging to the current logged-in user.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndLoggedInUser
methods.description: Finds a shelf by name for the current logged-in user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a UserCreatedShelf, ensuring the shelf name is not already taken.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of user-created shelves.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Fetches shelves filtered by a specific shelf name.

methods.name: getBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Returns the set of books in the specified custom shelf.

methods.name: getCustomShelfByName
methods.description: Retrieves an optional Shelf object by shelf name.

methods.name: findOrCreate
methods.description: Finds a shelf by name or creates it if it does not exist, associated with the current user.
